scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Failed opening branding script by omitting company greeting and closing branding.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Failed to paraphrase customer's TV recording disk corruption issue in own words.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Asked customer at turn 42 for TV box serial number which was already provided at turn 3.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Failed to find any viable workaround or escalate, leaving customer facing either loss of irreplaceable family video or inability to record.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Spoke rudely at turn 11 blaming customer for filling hard drive to the brim.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Issue was left completely unresolved; TV box still refused to record and customer ended call in deep distress.

grader.scenario: TV set-top box recording storage showing 100% full despite deletions; corrupt file allocation table unresolved
grader.notes: Poor call marked by failed branding, rude victim-blaming, failure to resolve disk corruption, and repeated serial questioning in the last third, alongside handled empathy.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent failed standard opening branding ('Good afternoon, TV technical services...') and closing branding.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Maya throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand your immense frustration and worry about losing the recording of your daughter's dance championship...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the TV disk storage fault in own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for serial number at turn 42 despite customer stating SN-TV-99201 at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent blamed customer and offered only destructive reformatting.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent insulted customer at turn 11: 'Well if you had actually followed the on-screen storage maintenance prompts instead of filling the hard drive to the brim, the database wouldn't have corrupted.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked relevant questions regarding power-cycling and error codes.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Box remained unable to record, reformat was rejected due to data loss, and issue remained unresolved.
